title: One-Step Text Generation by Seq-Drifting
abstract: arXiv:2610.12879v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but still require multiple sampling steps to produce high-quality text. In this paper, we investigate whether a model can learn to generate an entire sequence in a single forward pass. We propose Seq-Drifting, a framework that applies drifting to sequences of continuous token representations and directly learns a map from Gaussian noise to text. Unlike existing DLMs that derive the supervision at each position directly from the observed token in a training sequence, Seq-Drifting builds a drift field whose position-wise targets adapt to the current generated context. At each position, attraction guides each output toward a set of contextually plausible token representations, while repulsion discourages collapse across samples and repetition within sequences. The generator learns from this drift field during training and produces all tokens jointly in one pass at inference. Empirically

translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLM）可以并行生成词元，但仍需要多个采样步骤才能产生高质量文本。在本文中，我们研究模型是否能够学会在单次前向传播中生成整个序列。我们提出了Seq-Drifting，这是一个将漂移机制应用于连续词元表示序列的框架，它直接学习从高斯噪声到文本的映射。与现有扩散语言模型直接从训练序列中观察到的词元推导每个位置的监督信号不同，Seq-Drifting构建了一个漂移场，其逐位置目标会适应当前已生成的上下文。在每个位置上，吸引力引导每个输出趋向一组在上下文上合理的词元表示，而排斥力则防止不同样本之间的坍缩以及序列内部的重复。生成器在训练期间从这个漂移场中学习，并在推理时通过一次前向传播联合生成所有词元。
tldr: 该论文提出Seq-Drifting框架，通过构建具有上下文自适应目标的漂移场（结合吸引力与排斥力机制），使模型直接学习从高斯噪声到文本的映射，实现单次前向传播即可生成完整序列的文本。
en_tdlr: Seq-Drifting is a framework that learns a direct map from Gaussian noise to text via a context-adaptive drift field with attraction and repulsion forces, enabling full-sequence text generation in a single forward pass.
